Also obtain an expression for electric potential at a point due to a point charge.
Electric potential: The electric potential at a point inside the electric field is defined as the amount of work done in moving a unit positive charge (test charge) from infinity to that point.

Electric field: The electric field is defined as the region around the charge where electric force can be experienced. The electric field intensity E at a point inside the field is defined as the force experienced by unit positive charge when placed at that point.
They are not vector quantities because they do not obey the laws of vector algébra.
